$description: Shape and elevation. Elevation is tone; detachment is a boundary — plus exactly two shadows, each named for the one job it does (D-015, D-023, amended by D-075).

xs.$description: checkbox, keyboard hint, badge on an icon

md.$description: button, input, select, menu item, tab

lg.$description: card, table container, modal, menu panel

width.$description: the only border weight in the system

style.$description: applied as outline on :focus-visible, never :focus, never box-shadow

d3.why: Composed into the focus outline shorthand rather than emitted on its own.

elevation.$description: Deliberately not a shadow ramp. Resting surfaces differ by tone and carry no border. Floating layers sit at surface-raised and carry shadow-float; under forced-colors or prefers-contrast: more they go back to a 1px border-float at 3:1. The recessed shell's main content is the one resting surface that carries shadow-sheet. A modal adds a scrim; nothing else does.

d3.why: Prose: this states the elevation rule. The one resting surface with a shadow, the recessed shell's main, reads shadow.sheet (D-075).

floating.$value: surface-raised + shadow-float (1px border-float under forced-colors and prefers-contrast: more)

d3.why: Prose: this states the elevation rule. The shadow it names is emitted from shadow.float (D-075).

shadow.$description: Two shadows, and only two (D-075, DS-ADR-001). Not a ramp: each is named for the one job it does, and the usage guard admits exactly these two. The light and dark values are the sources; components read --shadow-sheet and --shadow-float, which follow the theme.

sheet.$description: The content sheet: AppShell navTone="recessed" <main> only.

light.$description: a CSS box-shadow list — a whisper that lifts the sheet off bg

dark.$description: a CSS box-shadow list — one tight edge; dark already separates by tone

float.$description: Floating layers: Menu, Tooltip, Toast, Modal, RecipientField's suggestion list. Always on surface-raised.

light.$description: a CSS box-shadow list — a 1px hairline ring in the divider colour, then the lift; the ring is what finds a white menu on a white card

dark.$description: a CSS box-shadow list — no ring: surface-raised is already a step above every ground in dark
